4.3.1.3.1 Initial Values
[SWS_Rte_06009] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00108
⌈For each data element in an interface specified with data semantics, the RTE shall support the initValue attribute.⌋ The initValue attribute is used to ensure that AUTOSAR software-components always access valid data even if no value has yet been received. This information is required for inter-ECU, inter-Partition, and intra-Partition communication. For inter-ECU communication initial values can be handled by COM but for intra-ECU communication RTE has to guarantee that initValue is handled. Please also note that in case of 1:N communication, it is possible to assign different initValues to each VariableDataPrototype. But this will lead to resource overhead since the RTE would need to allocate a buffer per configured initValue.
[SWS_Rte_06010] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00107
⌈The RTE shall use any specified initial value to prevent the receiver performing calculations based on invalid (i.e. uninitialized) values when the swImplPolicy is not queued and if the general initialization conditions in [SWS_Rte_07046] are fulfilled.⌋ The above requirement ensures that RTE API calls return the initialized value until a “real” value has been received, possibly via the communication service. The requirement does not apply when “event” semantics are used since the implied state change when the event data is received will mean that the receiver will not start to process invalid data and would therefore never see the initialized value. Note: In general it is not mandatory for a user to provide an initial value for sender/receiver communication, but some exceptions exist where users may force validation for the presence of initial values (see [SWS_Rte_07642], [SWS_Rte_08311] and
